request.style: English, gospel soul ballad, warm deep male lead vocal, gospel choir answering, piano, Hammond organ swells, soft bass and drums, hopeful and tender, building to a powerful final chorus, 68 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
Far from home by a foreign river
Hung my harp on the willow tree
Every road I knew was broken
Every dream was lost to me
Then a letter came one dusty morning
Build your house and plant the vine
Seek the peace of the city you live in
I have not forgotten mine

[Chorus]
I hold the thoughts I think of you
Thoughts of peace and not of harm
A future and a hope, my child
Held forever in my arms

[Verse]
Seventy years is a long time waiting
Children grow and the old ones sigh
But the One who counts the sparrows
Writes tomorrow in the sky

[Chorus]
I hold the thoughts I think of you
Thoughts of peace and not of harm
A future and a hope, my child
Held forever in my arms

[Bridge]
When you seek me, you will find me
When you search with all your heart
I will bring you home again
I will mend the broken parts

[Chorus]
I hold the thoughts I think of you
Thoughts of peace and not of harm
A future and a hope, my child
Held forever in my arms

[Outro]
A future and a hope
A future and a hope
Peace and not harm
A future and a hope
